print("=== Gray (g) objects after click ===")

# Find dark gray (G) objects

for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:

        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"  center~({sum(rows)//len(rows)},{sum(cols)//len(cols)}), pixels={n['pixels']}")

# Check changed cells
before = last_transition.before_frame
after = last_transition.after_frame
before_ascii = before.ascii.split('\n')
after_ascii = after.ascii.split('\n')

changes = []
for i, (bl, al) in enumerate(zip(before_ascii, after_ascii)):
    for j, (bc, ac) in enumerate(zip(bl, al)):
        if bc != ac:
            changes.append((i, j, bc, ac))

# Filter out HUD changes (row 0)
gameplay_changes = [(r,c,b,a) for r,c,b,a in changes if r > 0]
print(f"\nGameplay changes: {len(gameplay_changes)}")
